This is a FFmpeg Win32 and x64 shared builds.

Win32 build configuration:
    --prefix=build --arch=i686 --enable-shared --disable-static --disable-yasm --extra-libs=-static
x64 build configuration:
    --prefix=build --arch=x86_64 --enable-shared --disable-static --disable-yasm --extra-libs=-static

This build was made without any modification in FFmpeg source code. The source code for this FFmpeg build was downloaded from http://www.ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-2.0.2.tar.gz.

This build was compiled on Windows 7 64-bit using the MinGW-w64 toolchain: <http://mingw-w64.sourceforge.net/>
